llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to houseless leather artisans for constructing living cum work sheds through the Rajiv Gandhi Rural Housing Corporation.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be leather artisans belonging to the listed sub‑castes among scheduled castes, be at least 18 years old, have an annual family income not exceeding ₹32,000 in rural areas or ₹87,600 in urban areas, must not have received benefits from other schemes except Training/Paaduke kuteera schemes, and their family members should not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations.
